name: context-watch
description: Handoff layer 1 (IDE-147): the status line records context and five-hour usage per session; at 90% a PostToolUse hook tells the model, once per session, to finish the task in flight, commit, write handoff.md, push and report code 4. Advisory: it depends on the model obeying.
composition: A plugin cannot set a status line. Install it with `python3 scripts/hooks/statusline.py --install`, which wraps the status line already configured (Orca's, on this machine) instead of replacing it, prints what it wrapped, and is undone by --uninstall. Without the status line the hook has no numbers and stays silent.
